title: G5: Word target for lamps (S)
description:
Lamps can target a whole 32-bit word (not only a number): the lesson asks the student to make a given instruction word.
Acceptance:
- Given a word target, when the lamps match it, then the scene goal is met.
- The target is shown as the card text, not hex, unless the lesson asks for hex.
- Works with the 'number only' lens (R4).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Kept and re-parented to RM W4 (SIE-fd3dd9): a word target for lamps may be needed by the InstructionPanel lamps lens (SIE-2c1fb1) in c1/12-13; close if the lens makes it redundant.

right_now_summary: The word target remains tied to the InstructionPanel lamps lens and may be removed if that lens makes it unnecessary.
